by: in-repo evidence arm: bouncer check, the commit's developer simulated
decided: A missing or non-string summary becomes `""`.
Ticket: silent.
Instead: Throw an error, or return null or undefined for the summary.
A missing, null or non-string issue type name becomes `"Task"`.
Ticket: silent.
Instead: Use an empty string or "Unknown", or throw.
A missing or non-string `updated` becomes `null`.
Ticket: silent.
Instead: Throw, or use an empty string.
A null, missing or unrecognised description gives `descriptionText` `""`, and reading one never throws.
Ticket: silent.
Instead: Throw an error, or return null.
A plain-string description keeps its line feeds, has each run of other whitespace (spaces, tabs, `\r`) replaced by one space, and is trimmed.
Ticket: silent.
Instead: Return the string unchanged, or treat it as unsupported.
`descriptionText` is capped at 20,000 characters and gets `"\n[truncated]"` appended past that. The hash is taken from the capped text, so edits past the cap do not change it.
Ticket: silent.
Instead: No cap, or a cap with no marker, or hash the full text.

ADF renders as Markdown-like text: `#` headings, `- ` and `1. ` list markers, `- [x]` / `- [ ]` checkboxes, pipe-separated table rows, fenced code, `> ` quotes, `---` rules and `[media]` / `[media xN]` placeholders. Each block, list item, task item and table row is its own block, and blocks are joined with blank lines.
Ticket: silent.
Instead: Flatten everything to plain text with no markers, joined by single newlines.
An unknown ADF node never throws: it contributes its own non-empty `text`, otherwise its children. Non-object children are skipped.
Ticket: silent.
Instead: Skip unknown nodes, or throw.
Text in a paragraph is read when its text node is at depth 49 or less (the root is depth 0, and each `content` level adds one). Deeper text is dropped silently.
Ticket: silent.
Instead: No depth limit, or throw on excessive nesting.

Before hashing, line endings become `\n`, trailing whitespace is removed from each line, and each part is trimmed at both ends. Leading indentation, internal spaces, blank-line counts and case still change the hash.
Ticket: silent.
Instead: Hash the raw text, or collapse all whitespace.
`specHash` is the SHA-256 (via `crypto.subtle`) of `summary + "\u0000" + descriptionText`, both normalised and UTF-8 encoded, returned as 64 lowercase hex characters.
Ticket: silent.
Instead: Another hash such as SHA-1, MD5 or a non-crypto hash, base64 output, or JSON-encoding the pair.
An issue with no `fields` object is read as `toIssueSpec(key, {})`: empty summary and description, issue type `"Task"`, `updated` null.
Ticket: silent.
Instead: Throw an error.
The key is returned exactly as given and is not validated (`""` is accepted).
Ticket: silent.
Instead: Reject an empty or malformed issue key.
The returned `summary` is the raw string, untrimmed. Normalisation happens only inside the hash.
Ticket: silent.
Instead: Return the summary trimmed or whitespace-normalised.
An empty-string issue type name is kept as `""`. Only non-strings fall back to `"Task"`.
Ticket: silent.
Instead: Treat an empty name like a missing one and use `"Task"`.
Any string `updated` is passed through without parsing or validation.
Ticket: silent.
Instead: Parse it as an ISO date and return null when it is not one.
Text is not Unicode-normalised before hashing, so NFC and NFD spellings hash differently.
Ticket: silent.
Instead: Normalise both parts to NFC before hashing.
The 20,000 cap counts UTF-16 code units and may split a surrogate pair.
Ticket: silent.
Instead: Count code points and never split a character.
ADF text nodes keep their spacing as written. Only plain-string descriptions have whitespace runs collapsed.
Ticket: silent.
Instead: Collapse whitespace in ADF text the same way as in plain strings.

Missing or invalid ADF attributes fall back: heading level clamps to 1–6 (non-numeric is 1), list numbering starts at `attrs.order` or 1, a mention without a label is `@unknown`, and an emoji, card or date without its attribute contributes `""`.
Ticket: silent.
Instead: Drop the node, or throw, when an attribute is missing or invalid.
A `blockCard` at block level is treated as an unknown node. It has no text or children, so it contributes nothing. Its URL appears only when the card is inside a paragraph.
Ticket: silent.
Instead: Make a block-level card its own block holding its URL.
The result has exactly the six `JiraIssueSpec` properties, the `fields` argument is not modified, and calls share no state, so overlapping calls give the same results as sequential ones.
Ticket: silent.
Instead: Pass extra raw fields through on the result, or cache results across calls.
